requests.prompt:
Create a NEW ME1 game-ready spaceship sprite atlas by reinterpreting the supplied reference pictures. Do not alter the source files. Four separate isolated FULL SHIPS on true transparent RGBA, in a very clean evenly spaced 2-column x 2-row arrangement, landscape 1536 x 1024. Each quadrant contains ONE ship, entire silhouette including every engine, wing, pincer and antenna, with generous empty padding on ALL sides. No text or labels, no badges, no panel backgrounds, no planets, no stars, no smoke, no contrails, no shadows painted outside the ship. View is consistent orthographic three-quarter from slightly above, bow angled toward lower-left. Pre-rendered realistic HD 2D sprites for a French Mass Effect JRPG, detailed physically plausible hull, soft neutral light, crisp readable silhouettes, no cartoon or pixel art. All artwork remains a partial prototype.
TOP LEFT: SSV NORMANDY SR-1 from Mass Effect 1, specifically the sleek small Alliance stealth frigate in the FIRST supplied official manual image: flattened long white central hull, black dark cockpit inset and dark lower surfaces, burgundy/red Alliance striping, compact angular paired outrigger engine nacelles, rear dorsal fin. Preserve that recognizable SR-1 outline and proportions rather than the more generic large vessel in the second reference. NO Cerberus yellow.
TOP RIGHT: SOVEREIGN from Mass Effect 1. Ancient dark metallic squid/cuttlefish Reaper vessel with long tapered armored central shell and several curved articulated limbs/pincers at the front, small deep red emitters. Use the lower-right silhouette of the second reference as a style guide, but make the ENTIRE body and every tip visible. It must read as a ship, no face, no humanoid body.
BOTTOM LEFT: DESTINY ASCENSION, the Mass Effect 1 asari Council flagship, a majestic smooth pale lavender/blue-silver capital dreadnought with distinctive broad elegant organic curved wings/fins and a long tapering central form. Preserve the known in-game Destiny Ascension silhouette; no generic airplane, no Reaper tentacles, no Federation saucer.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a GETH DROPSHIP from Mass Effect 1, distinctive dark grey/black synthetic angular insect-like geth transport craft with long pointed wings/fins, compact central hull and cool blue emissive details. Use original ME1 recognizable design, not a helicopter, not a Star Wars shuttle, not a humanoid robot or walking armature.
No relative physical scale is implied by equally sized cells. Keep at least 36px genuine transparent margins around each complete ship and wide transparent gutters. Differentiate all four silhouettes clearly. No cropped elements, no repeated ship, no extra small vehicles, no visible writing.

Create a NEW four-ship reference sprite atlas for Mass Effect, derived stylistically from the supplied existing fleet atlas but with FOUR isolated FULL SPACESHIPS and no ground vehicles. True transparent RGBA, landscape 1536 x 1024, 2 columns x 2 rows, exactly ONE complete ship per quadrant with a minimum 36px clean transparent padding and generous gutters. No text, no labels, no panel backgrounds, no starfield, no planetary backgrounds, no halos, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no flame trails. Consistent orthographic three-quarter view from slightly above, bows pointing toward the lower-left. Pre-rendered realistic HD 2D spacecraft sprites, clean cinematic materials, neutral soft light, dark details readable at small game size, no pixel art, no chibi.
TOP LEFT: MASS EFFECT 2 NORMANDY SR-2 IN CERBERUS SERVICE. The larger streamlined SR-2 frigate, long sleek white/graphite central body, widely spread angular side engine nacelles, black cockpit, distinctive restrained yellow/gold Cerberus stripes. Correct recognizable SR-2 silhouette, NOT the first Normandy SR-1. Do not add fictional readable logos.
TOP RIGHT: MASS EFFECT 3 NORMANDY SR-2 IN ALLIANCE SERVICE. Clearly the same physical SR-2 hull design and silhouette as top-left, but with its ME3 Alliance white/navy/charcoal repaint and restrained red/blue accenting, NO yellow Cerberus livery. This is a separate era-appropriate drawing, not a duplicate copy.
BOTTOM LEFT: MASS EFFECT ANDROMEDA TEMPEST. Small unarmed exploration vessel, graceful elongated white/graphite hull and distinct sweeping split curved side engine arms with blue accents. Use the familiar in-game Tempest outline, as suggested by the lower-right ship of the reference, correcting interpretation toward the real recognizable exploration ship. No guns or military turrets.
BOTTOM RIGHT: MASS EFFECT ANDROMEDA HUMAN ARK HYPERION. Very large white/grey Andromeda Initiative colony ark, a long central spine with multiple massive balanced paired cryogenic habitat/engine modules; a clearly different massive modular ark silhouette from the three compact frigates. Correct recognizable Hyperion ark from Andromeda, no Reaper tentacles, no Normandy-shaped mini-frigate. Its equal cell size is for reference presentation, NOT a claim of physical scale.
Every wing, engine, tip, antenna and module must fit completely inside its cell with clean empty padding. No unrelated objects, no fifth ship. Four distinct era-specific reference sprites, partial prototypes rather than certified canonical models.
